verdict.rationale: Mastercard documents a dedicated Sandbox project on the Test Drive plan, which is non-billable, unlimited, and covers all Open Finance API endpoints. Testing runs against synthetic test banks (FinBanks), a test payroll provider (FinPayroll), and a set of testing personas, so no real customer data is involved. Mastercard's GitHub OpenAPI repo also includes a test project that generates a client library from the API spec. Missing for 10: an explicit statement on how sandbox credentials and data are isolated from production, and independent hands-on corroboration of the sandbox experience.
